title: Boundary edges of the Gotsman–Linial extremizer
statement: Let $m$ and $s$ be natural numbers, choose a coordinate $i$ among $m+1$ coordinates, and let $e$ be a cube point whose $i$th coordinate is $1$. The Gotsman–Linial extremizer with parameters $m+1$ and $s+1$ changes value across the edge at $e$ in coordinate $i$ if and only if, after removing coordinate $i$, the number of coordinates equal to $1$ is $(m-s)_+/2$ rounded down, plus some integer $j$ with $0\le j<s+1$; here $(m-s)_+=\max(m-s,0)$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is a cube point with $i$th coordinate equal to $1
